_readme: Voice casting for the AI Business Academy films — ElevenLabs edition.
POLICY (locked): voices are ORIGINAL synthetic designs from the ElevenLabs
Voice Library / Voice Design only. NEVER clone a real person's voice, and
never imitate a named actor or movie character — consent required, full stop.
voice_id is blank until you cast it: open your ElevenLabs account, pick or
design a voice using the 'direction' text below, then paste its voice ID
here (voice IDs are not secrets; the API key is — that stays in the
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable and is never committed).

narrator.label: Academy narrator (chronicles, teasers, lessons)
narrator.direction: Deep, gravelly, unhurried male storyteller in his sixties. Documentary gravity, warm not menacing. Lets pauses land after em-dashes. Library search terms: deep narrator, documentary, gravelly, cinematic.

mv-c1.direction: Calm, precise, mid-register. Measured dispatcher cadence — every word logged, assigned, closed. Slightly clipped efficiency, never cold. Library search terms: calm, precise, professional, composed.

mv-c2.direction: Low, warm workshop mentor. Patient and deliberate, like reading a well-worn manual aloud by a work light. Library search terms: warm, mature, mentor, steady.

mv-c3.direction: Crisp, bright, exact. Quick but never rushed — the friendly accountant who enjoys the moment the numbers finally tell the truth. Library search terms: crisp, articulate, bright, confident.

mv-c4.direction: Confident low-mid register, coiled energy, spare sentences. Says ninety words like each one cost money. Library search terms: confident, intense, low, controlled.

mv-c5.direction: Warm, resonant, expressive and unhurried — a voice that sounds like it remembers eleven years of kiln journals. Library search terms: warm, expressive, resonant, storyteller.
